user-research.name: User research
user-research.description: Study user needs and behavior through interviews, observation, and research synthesis.

usability-testing.name: Usability testing
usability-testing.description: Evaluate task completion and interface barriers through sessions with representative users.

information-architecture.name: Information architecture
information-architecture.description: Organize content and navigation around user tasks and clear structural relationships.

interaction-design.name: Interaction design
interaction-design.description: Define interface behavior, transitions, feedback, and recovery for user tasks.

wireframing.name: Wireframing
wireframing.description: Sketch interface structure and task flows before committing to visual detail.

prototyping.name: Prototyping
prototyping.description: Create interactive representations to test flows, behavior, and design assumptions.

visual-design.name: Visual interface design
visual-design.description: Apply typography, hierarchy, color, spacing, and layout to usable interfaces.

design-handoff.name: Design handoff
design-handoff.description: Document interface behavior, component states, assets, and accessibility needs for implementation.

research-synthesis.name: Research synthesis
research-synthesis.description: Translate research observations into supported themes, user needs, and design opportunities.

journey-mapping.name: User journey mapping
journey-mapping.description: Map user goals, steps, touchpoints, and barriers across a service experience.

product-discovery.name: Product discovery
product-discovery.description: Investigate customer problems and validate opportunities before committing delivery effort.

product-requirements.name: Product requirements
product-requirements.description: Define behavior, acceptance criteria, constraints, and measurable outcomes.

user-stories.name: User stories
user-stories.description: Describe user needs and acceptance criteria in small, testable product increments.

backlog-management.name: Backlog management
backlog-management.description: Maintain an ordered backlog with scope, dependencies, and readiness criteria.

product-prioritization.name: Product prioritization
product-prioritization.description: Compare opportunities using customer value, evidence, effort, risk, and strategic fit.

product-roadmapping.name: Product roadmapping
product-roadmapping.description: Connect outcomes to sequenced initiatives, dependencies, and review points.

market-analysis.name: Market analysis
market-analysis.description: Assess customer segments, alternatives, market conditions, and unmet needs.

product-metrics.name: Product metrics
product-metrics.description: Define success through measurable activation, usage, retention, and business outcomes.

launch-planning.name: Product launch planning
launch-planning.description: Coordinate readiness, rollout stages, support needs, and outcome measurement.

product-strategy.name: Product strategy
product-strategy.description: Choose target problems, differentiated value, and priorities using market and customer evidence.

pricing-analysis.name: Pricing analysis
pricing-analysis.description: Evaluate pricing and packaging through customer value, costs, demand, and usage evidence.

portfolio-management.name: Product portfolio management
portfolio-management.description: Allocate investment across products using strategic fit, dependencies, risk, and measured results.
